statement: On connect Linux resets the LEDs, sets the lightbar to blue (0,0,128) and lights the centred player pattern for its assigned player ID. SDL reads feature 0x03 capability bits (byte 4 bit 2 lightbar, byte 20 bit 7 player LEDs), then sets lightbar colour from a seven-entry player colour table (blue, red, green, pink, orange, teal, white) and the matching player pattern, again on every player-index change; a hint can switch SDL's player lights off.
